title: Just messing around with a CK3/Rimworld bash style game
author: JesseSuave
selftext:
It's been an absolute blast to work on so far as a hobby project, made me realize how powerful these tools are. Sent me tumbling down the rabbit hole of Local LLMs, context/tokens etc.

Glad there's a community of people who do the same thing!

Game is called Crown of Thatch but that's a working title currently. If anyone is interested I have a discord setup to follow development but again its a hobby project so don't expect anything crazy.

comments.author: Novel_Cucumber_1588
comments.body: looks awesome. bit hard to image how CK3 ish style will be introduced by rimworld like vibes look legit

replies.author: JesseSuave
replies.body: Thanks! I appreciate it! Basically you have a power struggle to maintain leadership of a village (or just give it up and go full guild market manipulation mode) and your family is at the core of that power struggle. Ensuring your kids are trained and apprenticed properly so when your main character dies they leave a proper foundation for their offspring. The computer players are competing against you the whole time as well.

comments.author: illtal
comments.body:
Right now, what AI like LLMs handles seems to be mostly functional implementation.

Living in a world where you can build what you imagine and plan without knowing how to code really feels like a singularity.

Turn your imagination into reality!

In the end, though, judgments about fun, narrative, and visuals are things humans have to decide and think through.

Will there ever come a time when AI truly understands what play is?
